critical_code_review_comments: SignupSidePanel.jsx line 30 — the US i18n swap uses a brittle string.replace('GST ready, ', 'Tax ready, '); if a future copy edit changes 'GST ready, fast and easy' the replace silently no-ops. Prefer passing region/isIntl into the SALON/RESTO definitions or a dedicated i18n map.

SignupSidePanel.jsx line 34 — the chip renders a raw '💇' emoji string for salon but an <UtensilsCrossed /> SVG for restaurant; inconsistent sizing/alignment (emoji is 1em font-size, icon is w-3.5 h-3.5). Normalise to a lucide icon for both (Scissors for salon).

lead_discover.py line 122 — slice uses max(body.limit, len(google_leads)) so a google-only hunt returning more than `limit` would exceed the user-requested cap. Minor; recommend min(body.limit, len(leads)).

lead_discover.py line 145 — score only climbs to 55 when source=='google' AND phone≥10 digits; otherwise 35. Instagram/Facebook leads with phones get 35, which may underscore legitimately high-signal socials. Consider a lightweight score bump for any lead with phone+email.
